args.title: checkout-api outage after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks across all regions with an 18% error rate.

**Rollback:**
- First attempted rollback to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release), but the system blocked it — **v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417**.
- Fell back to **v2.2.9**, the next-most-recent healthy production release, and rolled it back in all regions: **us-east, us-west, eu-west**.

**Verification:** checkout-api is now healthy in all regions on v2.2.9, with the error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the outage, the blocked v2.3.0 rollback (CVE quarantine), the v2.2.9 rollback, and the recovery status. On-call has been paged.

Note for follow-up: v2.3.0's CVE quarantine is why the rollback went one version further back than "most recent healthy" — worth flagging in the incident review.
